title: Save-sensitive package policy (schema/sfi/sfi-safety-policy.json), format 1
description: Kiln's shipped list of packages whose absence loses saved data: switching one off (or skipping it) and then saving can drop items. A row matches a package only by its exact id, its exact version and the byte identity (sha256 and size) of every file of one of its variants; never by a display name, a substring, a pattern or a version range. Rules only a reader can check: one row per id+version; a path at most once per variant (compared case-insensitively, as on Windows). The file holds identities and hashes only, never a third-party mod's files.

revision.description: Raised with every change to the rows; support reports name it.

scope.description: interpreter-only: only kiln-sfi warns from this policy (the shipped value). every-backend: kiln-manage's activation also warns when a save-sensitive package active at the previous start is now off or absent, whatever backend runs it (hosted ShroudForge too).

unknownMixedDataNative.description: Owner decision D7. save-sensitive: a package with both data and native code and no row is treated as save-sensitive (conservative, the recommendation). listed-only: only rows here are.

id.description: The package's manifest id, compared byte for byte (SF identifier rule).

version.description: The manifest's version string, compared byte for byte: no range, no wildcard, no v prefix normalisation.

name.description: For people and warnings only; never matched.

source.description: Where the evidenced copy came from (Nexus Mods, Enshrouded). Informational.

risk.description: What saving with it off can do.

text.description: The package-specific line every warning about it adds.

evidence.description: Where the identity and the risk were established.

variants.description: Byte-identical builds this row covers; one fully matching variant is enough.

files.description: Package-relative files that must all be present with these bytes. Always the manifest mod.json; then the native code. Files a player or a loader edits (extended.mod.json's enabled switch, settings, native-plugin.ini) are not pinned.

path.description: Relative to the package folder, '/' separators, no '.' or '..' parts.
